N001.summary: Early game phase with moderate production and heavy technology investment, economy and expansion heavy. Maintain current development path: continue economy and technology investment, keep production moderate, and avoid overcommitting to a specific army composition until more information is available.
N001.title: Early Game Development
N001.trigger_summary: Early game phase with moderate production and heavy technology investment, economy and expansion heavy.

N002.summary: Early-midgame phase with ground army orientation, heavy production and technology, economy and expansion heavy. Maintain your ground army path and continue heavy production and technology. Keep expanding and developing your economy.
N002.title: Ground Army Transition
N002.trigger_summary: Early-midgame phase with ground army orientation, heavy production and technology, economy and expansion heavy.

N003.summary: Midgame phase with heavy ground army, heavy production and technology, heavy defense and expansion. Maintain your current army composition and production. Continue to expand and tech up, but also consider adding air units or upgrades to counter potential threats.
N003.title: Midgame Consolidation
N003.trigger_summary: Midgame phase with heavy ground army, heavy production and technology, heavy defense and expansion.
